name: stri_info
title: Query Stringi and ICU Build Information

origin.description: Report the ICU build, the Unicode version, and the current locale.

arguments.name: short
arguments.text: TRUE returns one summary line. FALSE returns the full list.

origin.details: The short line names the package version, the default locale, the friendly charset name, the ICU version, whether ICU is the system library, the U_CHARSET_IS_UTF8 flag, and the Unicode version. The long form also lists the internal charsets and the native converter.
origin.value: A named list, or one string when short is TRUE.

translation.description: Report the ICU build, the Unicode version, and the current locale.

arguments.name: short
arguments.text: True returns one summary line. False returns a dictionary.

translation.details: The linked library is ICU 76.1 and Unicode 16.0. The native charset block is the UTF-8 converter reported while U_CHARSET_IS_UTF8 is set. A missing logical in that block is stringi._na.NA. The package version in the short line is 1.8.9.
translation.value: A dict, or one string when short is True.
